We are recruiting a fulltime board certified/board eligible surgeon with experience in orthopedic spine surgery. Candidates with subspecialty specific surgical fellowships are welcome to apply. Primary responsibilities of this position include developing an elective surgical practice at the UCI Health community clinical sites and covering general orthopedic and spine surgery call. The ideal candidate will be motivated to grow a practice and foster collegial relationships with community-based physicians, specialty surgeons, and other providers across the UCI Health system.

This opportunity will be a part of the expanding Specialty Care Associates (SCA) community network at UCI, working alongside other physicians and surgeons in the SCA network. UCI is a leader in patient quality and safety outcomes.
Your Role on the Team
Provide excellent clinical care.
Coverage of orthopedic spine surgery at UCI community sites.
Build and expand an elective surgical clinical practice.
Communicate and collaborate with faculty, colleagues, residents, fellows, staff, and peers to maintain a professional, team-based approach to patient care.
Adhere to departmental policies, procedures, and objectives and comply with all UC policies and procedures.
Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with all state and federal privacy laws.
